source_claim_groups.title: Exact cut-comparison cover
source_claim_groups.statement: For every restored classical oracle and every cut, H_i<=f and OR_i H_i=f.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: All 276 functions through three inputs, with explicitly constructed restored circuits.
source_claim_groups.boundary: No universal circuit-size lower bound follows solely from packet count.

source_claim_groups.title: Complete-cover lower bound and dual certificates
source_claim_groups.statement: T>=max(0,deg(f)-1,2 beta*(f)-3), with exact evaluation-span characterization of beta_v.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: Full four-input profile table; independent rank checks only on the documented 765 cases.
source_claim_groups.boundary: beta*<=n; bounded controls are not universal machine checking.

source_claim_groups.title: Unbalanced-OR calibration
source_claim_groups.statement: For k>=2, F_k=ab OR product(z_i): max affine alpha_1=3 and beta*=k+1.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: Full designated family tables through nine inputs; all affine masks only through eight.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Easy linear-size family; no exact optimum claimed when lower and upper bounds differ.

source_claim_groups.title: Optimal small restored oracles
source_claim_groups.statement: The complete-cover bound is attained by explicit classical implementations for all functions on one, two, or three inputs.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: All 276 functions; 28 zero-, 120 one-, and 128 three-Toffoli implementations.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Optimality combines the written lower bound and constructed witnesses; not exhaustive circuit search.

source_claim_groups.title: Projection cost and safety counterexample
source_claim_groups.statement: A family with n=2^m-2 has T(P_m)=2m-3 and T([P_m]_2)=n/2; the extracted grade can be unsafe.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: Ranks and pair coefficients through m=10; full truth tables only m=2,3,4.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Exponential in m, linear in n; not an exponential total-gate separation.

source_claim_groups.title: Faithful flat gluing dimension
source_claim_groups.statement: A linear multiplicative witness-algebra map retaining every primitive witness idempotent has target dimension at least 2^m.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: Small scalar-map controls; the universal argument is orthogonal-idempotent independence.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Restricted fixed-summary theorem; dimension is not arbitrary circuit cost.

source_claim_groups.title: Weighted witness fingerprint
source_claim_groups.statement: Distinct witness monomials give an exact nonzero/satisfiable equivalence and Boolean top-coefficient identity.
source_claim_groups.status: FINITE and WRITTEN; algorithmic implication CONDITIONAL
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: All designated verifiers through three witness bits; exact GF16 evaluation and specified extraction grids.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Implemented evaluator is exponential. An efficient evaluator would give the stated randomized implication, not a deterministic P=NP proof.

source_claim_groups.title: Overlap obstruction to multiplicative trace
source_claim_groups.statement: The weighted trace multiplies on disjoint variables and fails on the displayed overlapping one-bit predicates.
source_claim_groups.finite_scope: Exact GF16 counterexamples and 4,096 disjoint controls.
source_claim_groups.boundary: Does not exclude context-dependent nonlinear algorithms.
